# SilverSea 0.1.13

Removing a download is clearer and more reliable in this update.

## What’s new

- Choose whether to keep or delete partially downloaded files when removing a transfer.
- Removed downloads now disappear from the Downloads page right away.
- File cleanup runs in the background to prevent the app from becoming unresponsive.

## Install or update

Download **SilverSea-Setup.exe** below and run it. Your library and settings are kept when you install an update.
